H03.note: Converged on direction: AND by default, retaining explicit union and intersection and rejecting unknown modes. This records direction, not unanimous formal approval or implementation uptake. Document the migration for both-lists/no-mode queries.

H13.note: The current draft permits nonce-mismatch simulation. Erigon explicitly favors full transaction validation instead, including nonce, balance and EIP-3607. A mismatched-nonce CREATE fixture is needed to test the execution consequences before settling the policy.
